inspiration: Battle list as a live target strip: filters by type (players, NPCs, monsters, skulls, party), sorts by distance, type or health, and re-sorts when the player moves. For a 375-wide touch UI, a short filtered list with distance ordering is the useful part. Ref: modules/game_battle/battle.lua lines 237-262 (filter), 281-290 (distance sort on move).

Death presentation: a plain window states the penalty, and a partial penalty gets a different sentence from a full one, plus a short centre-screen line. Keeps a loss readable and fair-feeling. Ref: modules/game_playerdeath/playerdeath.lua lines 30-57.

Fight stance as a three-step selector (offensive, balanced, defensive) plus a chase toggle and a safe-fight toggle, each sent to the engine on change. A small readable stance switch for the fight. Ref: modules/game_combatcontrols/combatcontrols.lua lines 204-229.

Cooldown effect as data: a short burst of particles with an attraction affector that pulls them back to the centre, so a ready cooldown reads as a collapse rather than a flash. Keep the burst-then-collapse shape; use our own motion. Ref: data/particles/particles.otps (effect name at line 2 and the effect block below it).

Minimap: a saved map file is loaded and saved through loadMap and saveMap, a camera marker is updated by updateCameraPosition, and a full-map toggle opens the larger view; the full map is a user-supplied file (FULL MINIMAP Installation ReadMe.txt). For us: a zone map baked at build time, same toggle. Ref: modules/game_minimap/minimap.lua lines 98-131 (loadMap, saveMap, updateCameraPosition) and 144 (toggleFullMap). The per-floor detail was not read.
Font set with monochrome, antialiased and rounded variants per size: crisp small text for dense HUD labels. Ref: data/fonts/*.otfont (names only; sheets not opened).

briefs.label: Target strip with distance order (hud-ui)
briefs.why: A short, filtered list of nearby foes, always sorted by distance, lets a phone player pick a target without reading a long list.
briefs.keep: filter chips by type; distance sort that re-sorts on each move; a party flag
briefs.change: a three-slot touch strip with a threat shape instead of text rows; colour secondary; party marked by a ring not a shield

briefs.label: Cooldown collapse burst (vfx)
briefs.why: A ready cooldown that pulls its sparks inward reads as a click; the same motion can mark a finisher ready.
briefs.keep: a short burst followed by an attraction pull to the centre
briefs.change: a ring that collapses on our own axis; a soft sound cue on the collapse; no straight-out burst

briefs.label: Penalty window wording (death and respawn)
briefs.why: A loss that states its exact cost in plain words is easier to accept than a vague one, and a partial penalty reads differently from a full one.
briefs.keep: one plain window; a partial-penalty sentence; a short centre line
briefs.change: a respawn countdown instead of a close button; our own sentences; a grey-out, not a flash

briefs.label: Stance selector (fight modes)
briefs.why: Three stances as a segmented control make the risk dial visible during a fight.
briefs.keep: three steps (offensive, balanced, defensive); a chase toggle; a safe-fight toggle
briefs.change: a ring selector around the fighter instead of a toolbar; a lock icon for chase; our own stance names
